## Citi Trends Sets Date for Second Quarter Earnings Release and Conference Call


July 25, 2014


[Citi Trends Sets Date for Second Quarter Earnings Release and Conference Call](https://ir.cititrends.com/static-files/10e26643-c676-4cc9-89fa-886987341b0f)


SAVANNAH, Ga., July 25, 2014 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Citi Trends, Inc. (Nasdaq:CTRN) today announced details for the release of its results for the second quarter ending August 2, 2014.


Citi Trends plans to release its earnings for the second quarter before the market opens on Wednesday, August 20, 2014. Citi Trends will host a conference call on the same day at 9 a.m. ET. The number to call for the live interactive teleconference is (212) 231-2908. A replay of the conference call will be available until August 27, 2014, by dialing (402) 977-9140 and entering the passcode, 21705727.


The live broadcast of Citi Trends' conference call will be available online at the Company's website,[www.cititrends.com](http://www.cititrends.com/) , as well as[www.cititrends.com/http/ircititrendscom](http://www.cititrends.com/http/ircititrendscom) , on August 20, 2014, beginning at 9 a.m. ET. The online replay will follow shortly after the call and will be available for replay for one year.


During the conference call, the Company may discuss and answer questions concerning business, financial developments and trends after quarter-end. The Company's responses to questions, as well as other matters discussed during the conference call, may contain or constitute information that has not been disclosed previously.


***About Citi Trends***


Citi Trends, Inc. is a value-priced retailer of urban fashion apparel and accessories for the entire family. The Company operates 505 stores located in 29 states. Citi Trends' website address is[www.cititrends.com](http://www.cititrends.com/) . *CTRN-E*
